messages:
carla-cs: Heads-up — AcmeHealth opened a SEV: their latency dashboard p95/p99 lines are gone since ~2026-03-10 03:02 UTC. Screenshot attached. They say endpoints look OK but tenant-scoped tails are blank.
priya-support: Thanks, Carla. Can you paste the org/tenant id so I can pull logs? Any API error spikes from the customer?
carla-cs: org_id: acmehealth-42, tenant: acme-prod. They reported a few intermittent 500s hitting /v1/infer around 03:05 UTC but app still responding.
ryan-sre: Quick check from our side: org-level dashboards still show p95/p99. Tenant-scoped panels for acme-prod return no series. Other tenants unaffected. Suspect label mapping change during last night's routing cutover. Pinging @mike-ops for deploy context.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: deployment "metrics-router v3.1.0" promoted to prod by @mike-ops at 2026-03-10T03:01:55Z
mike-ops: Confirmed — we flipped metrics-router to the new tenant-key mapping to reduce cardinality. Canary looked fine, rollout at 03:00.
victor-platform: Able to reproduce locally. New router drops the tenant tag for legacy mappings (we missed acmehealth-42 in the mapping table). That would make tenant-scoped queries return empty series while org-level aggregates still exist. Repro query (returns zero rows for tenant):
```flux
from(bucket:\"metrics\")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == \"latency\" and r.org == \"acmehealth-42\" and r._field == \"p95\")
```
priya-support: Customer asks for ETA and if there's a quick dashboard workaround we can give them right now.
ryan-sre: Short-term workaround: switch their dashboard to group by org (org-level panels show tails). Long-term: either revert the router change or run a small backfill to restore tenant tag for affected shards. I'm drafting a rollback PR. Assigning to @mike-ops to approve rollback or hotfix.
mike-ops: Opening hotfix branch now to restore legacy mapping for known legacy-tenants. If rollback approved, will push in ~30m. Marking SEV and starting rollback.
carla-cs: Noted. I told AcmeHealth we'll have an update in 30 mins. They asked whether this impacts billing or SLA counts — they saw some latency noise but no sustained error flood.
ryan-sre: Filed INT-9876 (P0) with repro, timeline, and mitigation steps. If rollback misses any tenant we'll run a backfill job and update dashboards once done. Posting playbook in the ticket when complete. :thumbsup:
